Our Process

From Fresh Fruit to Export-Ready Powder

Strict quality control at every step ensures safety, consistency, and compliance.

1

Fresh Fruit Sourcing

Contracted farms in Eastern Thailand. IQF frozen or fresh within 24hrs of harvest.

2

Spray Drying

Low-temp spray drying with maltodextrin carrier preserves flavor, color, and nutrients.

3

QC Lab Testing

Every batch tested for micro, moisture, heavy metals, pesticides. COA issued.

4

Export Docs

Full export documentation: COA, Phytosanitary, Health Cert, FDA prior notice.
